newsitem.title: CHINA: China says dissident case no impact on U.S. ties.
newsitem.headline: China says dissident case no impact on U.S. ties.

text.p: China said on Thursday the jailing of dissident Wang Dan for 11 years would not effect Sino-U.S. relations and said the case was not a human rights issue but a normal legal matter.
"The case of Wang Dan has nothing to do with the issue of human rights," Foreign Ministry spokesman Shen Guofang told a new briefing.

"I don't think the case of Wang Dan will have any effect on Sino-U.S. relations," Shen said, when asked about the impact on relations after Washington expressed concern shortly after Wang was sentenced on Wednesday for plotting to subvert the government.
"The trial of Wang Dan is entirely a Chinese legal procedure carried out in accordance with the law," he said.
"It has no connection with human rights or other issues," Shen said.
